name: alex-act-enterprise
description: Alex ACT config-template plugin for the public Microsoft ecosystem. Ships the setup-enterprise-stack skill and /alex-act-enterprise setup-enterprise command that emit or auto-install the enabledPlugins block for seven public Microsoft plugins any tenant can use: azure (azure-skills), fabric-consumption + fabric-skills + fabric-operations + fabric-authoring (copilot-plugins), powerbi-authoring (fabric-collection), and microsoft-365-agents-toolkit (copilot-plugins). Composes on top of the public alex-act-core runtime. Not internal-only (that's alex-act-msft).
